description: Fixed recall probe set for Memora hybrid search. {{RUN}} is a per-run unique token (keeps runs isolated in the shared production corpus and makes cleanup auditable); {{TAIL}} is a short per-run suffix. The set extends the guarantees proven by TASK-REL-013 (semantic paraphrase), TASK-REL-024 (graph saturation), TASK-REL-027 (experience-record type fidelity, consumed by FRIDAY's presentation filter) and TASK-REL-031 / TASK-REL-014 (forget targeting inside the limit-25 mutation window).
